translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Intraday rules (ORB, CPR, Camarilla, midday lull) are written for 5m/15m lanes; daily-bar variants are marked as approximations.

strategies.name: TTM Squeeze
strategies.entry: count(bb_upper(close, 20, 2) < kc_upper(20, 1.5) and bb_lower(close, 20, 2) > kc_lower(20, 1.5), 5)[1] >= 5 and not (bb_upper(close, 20, 2) < kc_upper(20, 1.5) and bb_lower(close, 20, 2) > kc_lower(20, 1.5)) and close > close[12]
assumptions: Keltner = EMA(20) +/- 1.5 x ATR(20); squeeze on each of the previous 5 bars; momentum > 0 approximated by close above close 12 bars ago (TTM uses a linear-regression momentum)

strategies.name: Bollinger Band Width 6-Month Low
strategies.entry: bb_width(close, 20, 2)[1] == lowest(bb_width(close, 20, 2), 120)[1] and close > bb_upper(close, 20, 2)

strategies.name: NR7 (Crabel)
strategies.entry: (high - low)[1] == lowest(high - low, 7)[1] and close > high[1]
assumptions: 'Price > High[t-1]' evaluated on the close of bar t (an intrabar stop entry is not simulated)

strategies.name: NR4 in Uptrend
strategies.entry: close > sma(close, 50) and (high - low)[1] == lowest(high - low, 4)[1] and high > high[1]

strategies.name: NR7 + Inside Bar (NR7-ID)
strategies.entry: (high - low)[1] == lowest(high - low, 7)[1] and high[1] < high[2] and low[1] > low[2]
assumptions: setup completes at t-1; entry at the open after bar t

strategies.name: Inside Bar Breakout
strategies.entry: high[1] < high[2] and low[1] > low[2] and close > high[2]

strategies.name: Double Inside Bar (II)
strategies.entry: high[1] < high[2] and low[1] > low[2] and high[2] < high[3] and low[2] > low[3] and close > high[3]
assumptions: Mother_Bar = bar t-3

strategies.name: Fakey (Inside Bar False Breakout)
strategies.entry: high[1] < high[2] and low[1] > low[2] and low < low[2] and close > high[1]

strategies.name: Minervini VCP
strategies.entry: (highest(high, 10) - lowest(low, 10)) / highest(high, 10) < $d3 and (highest(high, 20) - lowest(low, 20)) / highest(high, 20) < ((highest(high, 40) - lowest(low, 40)) / highest(high, 40))[20] and sma(volume, 10) < sma(volume, 50) and close > highest(high, 10)[1]
assumptions: pullback depths approximated by range/high over 40-bar (older), 20-bar and 10-bar windows; tightening = each window shallower than the earlier one; volume dry-up = SMA10 < SMA50; trigger = close above the 10-bar high

strategies.name: ATR Contraction Base
strategies.entry: atr(14) == lowest(atr(14), 60) and close >= 0.92 * highest(high, 252)

strategies.name: ATR Volatility Breakout (Keltner Impulse)
strategies.entry: close > close[1] + 2.0 * atr(14) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)

strategies.name: Choppiness Index Trend Awakening
strategies.entry: chop(14)[2] > 61.8 and cross_below(chop(14), 50) and close > ema(close, 20)

strategies.name: Chaikin Volatility Expansion
strategies.entry: cross_above(chaikin_vol(10, 10), 0.20) and close > highest(high, 20)[1]

strategies.name: Historical Volatility Ratio Compression (Connors)
strategies.entry: hv(6)[1] / hv(100)[1] < 0.50 and close > highest(high, 3)[1]
assumptions: compression measured on the prior bar; 'break of 3-bar high' evaluated on the close

strategies.name: Standard Deviation Channel Squeeze
strategies.entry: stdev(close, 10) == lowest(stdev(close, 10), 60) and close > sma(close, 50)

strategies.name: 15-Minute Opening Range Breakout (ORB-15)
strategies.entry: close > or_high(15) and not (close[1] > or_high(15)[1]) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20) and close > vwap

strategies.name: 30-Minute Opening Range Breakout (ORB-30)
strategies.entry: close > or_high(30) and not (close[1] > or_high(30)[1]) and close > prev_day_high

strategies.name: 5-Minute ORB on Gap-Up Stocks
strategies.entry: day_open > prev_day_high * 1.01 and close > or_high(5) and not (close[1] > or_high(5)[1])

strategies.name: ORB + Inside Day (ORB-ID)
strategies.entry: prev_day_high(1) < prev_day_high(2) and prev_day_low(1) > prev_day_low(2) and close > max(or_high(15), prev_day_high(1)) and not (close[1] > max(or_high(15), prev_day_high(1))[1])

strategies.name: ORB Failure / Bull Trap Reversal
strategies.entry: any_of(high > or_high(15), 6) and cross_below(close, or_low(15))
assumptions: the failed breakout above the ORB high happened within the last 6 bars; the 'low volume' qualifier is not modelled

strategies.name: Breakaway Gap Up on Volume
strategies.entry: open > highest(high, 30)[1] * 1.01 and close > open and volume > 2.5 * sma(volume, 20)

strategies.name: Gap and Go (Power Earnings Gap)
strategies.entry: (open - close[1]) / close[1] > 0.03 and low >= open * 0.99
assumptions: the full-day low replaces the first-15-minute low (stricter); the earnings/news catalyst is not verified

strategies.name: Bullish Gap Fill Reversal
strategies.entry: open < low[1] and close > close[1]
assumptions: daily bars: 'crosses above Close[t-1]' confirmed on the close; entry next open

strategies.name: Bearish Exhaustion Gap Fade
strategies.entry: rsi(close, 14)[1] > 75 and open > high[1] * 1.03 and close < open
assumptions: daily red candle replaces the first 15-minute red candle

strategies.name: Oops! Reversal (Larry Williams)
strategies.entry: open < low[1] and high > low[1]
assumptions: intraday buy-stop at yesterday's low replaced by entry at the next open after the qualifying day

strategies.name: Island Cluster Reversal
strategies.entry: low > high[1] and any_of(high < low[1], 10)[1]
assumptions: a gap down occurred within the previous 10 bars (the island) and today gaps above yesterday's high

strategies.name: CPR Narrow Width Breakout
strategies.entry: abs(2 * (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high + prev_day_low)) / ((prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3) < 0.002 and close > max(2 * (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2, (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2) and not (close[1] > max(2 * (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2, (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2)[1])
assumptions: P = (H+L+C)/3, BC = (H+L)/2, TC = 2P - BC from the previous session; |TC-BC| = |2P - (H+L)|

strategies.name: CPR Narrow Width Breakout (daily bars)
strategies.entry: abs(2 * (high[1] + low[1] + close[1]) / 3 - (high[1] + low[1])) / ((high[1] + low[1] + close[1]) / 3) < $w and close > max(2 * (high[1] + low[1] + close[1]) / 3 - (high[1] + low[1]) / 2, (high[1] + low[1]) / 2)
assumptions: daily close above the narrow CPR replaces the 15-minute breakout

blocked.reason: needs stateful tracking of whether each prior session's CPR zone has been touched since it formed (a per-level 'untested' state); the DSL has no multi-level zone memory

strategies.name: Ascending CPR Trend Alignment
strategies.entry: min(2 * (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2, (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2) > max(2 * (prev_day_high(2) + prev_day_low(2) + prev_day_close(2)) / 3 - (prev_day_high(2) + prev_day_low(2)) / 2, (prev_day_high(2) + prev_day_low(2)) / 2) and close > max(2 * (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2, (prev_day_high + prev_day_low) / 2) and close > vwap
assumptions: BC/TC ordered by min/max because TC can fall below BC

strategies.name: Camarilla H4 Breakout (Momentum Day)
strategies.entry: close > prev_day_close + 1.1 * (prev_day_high - prev_day_low) / 2 and not (close[1] > prev_day_close + 1.1 * (prev_day_high - prev_day_low) / 2) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)

strategies.name: Camarilla H4 Breakout (daily bars)
strategies.entry: close > close[1] + 1.1 * (high[1] - low[1]) / 2 and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: daily close above H4 replaces the 15-minute close

strategies.name: Chandelier Exit Breakout Re-Entry
strategies.entry: cross_above(close, highest(high, 22) - 3 * atr(22))

strategies.name: Donchian Width Squeeze
strategies.entry: (highest(high, 20)[1] - lowest(low, 20)[1]) / lowest(low, 20)[1] < $w and close > highest(high, 20)[1]
assumptions: width measured on the 20 bars before the breakout bar (the literal includes the breakout bar's own high)

strategies.name: Mass Index Reversal Bulge
strategies.entry: any_of(mass_index(9, 25) > 27, 25)[1] and cross_below(mass_index(9, 25), 26.5) and close < ema(close, 9)[5]
assumptions: the reversal bulge is direction-neutral; the long interpretation requires a prior decline (close below its 9-EMA of 5 bars ago)

strategies.name: Ulcer Index Low-Stress Uptrend
strategies.entry: roc(close, 20) > 0.10 and ulcer(14) < 3.0

strategies.name: Relative Volatility Index (Dorsey) Breakout
strategies.entry: cross_above(100 * ema(iff(close > close[1], stdev(close, 10), 0), 14) / (ema(iff(close > close[1], stdev(close, 10), 0), 14) + ema(iff(close < close[1], stdev(close, 10), 0), 14)), 50) and close > high[1]

strategies.name: Midday Lull Breakout (11:30-13:15)
strategies.entry: minute_of_session == 255 and close > window_high(135, 240) and window_high(135, 240) - window_low(135, 240) < 0.3 * htf(atr(14), "1d")
assumptions: minutes after 09:15: 11:30 = 135, 13:15 = 240, 13:30 = 255; daily ATR is the previous completed session's

strategies.name: Wide Range Bar Ignition
strategies.entry: (high - low) == highest(high - low, 10) and (close - low) / (high - low) > 0.90

strategies.name: WRB Hidden Gap Absorption
strategies.entry: (high - low)[3] == highest(high - low, 10)[3] and close[3] > open[3] and lowest(low, 3) > low[3] + 0.7 * (high[3] - low[3])
assumptions: WRB at t-3 (a bullish wide-range bar); the next 3 bars hold the top 30%

blocked.reason: needs the per-session NSE price band (5/10/20%) to know the circuit price; inferring the band from price moves is not allowed
blocked.proposed_data: NSE daily security-wise price band files (sec_list / price-band changes), browser-downloaded and manifest-registered

strategies.name: Volatility Stop Flip
strategies.entry: cross_above(close, vstop(20, 2.0))

strategies.name: Bollinger Band Walk
strategies.entry: all_of(close > bb_upper(close, 20, 1), 5) and bb_width(close, 20, 2) > bb_width(close, 20, 2)[1]

strategies.name: GAPO Smooth Trend
strategies.entry: gapo(14) < $g and close > sma(close, 50)
assumptions: GAPO = log(highest-lowest)/log(n) depends on the rupee price level, so the 0.40 threshold is only meaningful for low-priced stocks; alternatives chosen on discovery

strategies.name: Fractal Chaos Bands Breakout
strategies.entry: close > swing_high(2) and swing_high(2)[1] == swing_high(2)[5]
assumptions: Upper fractal band = last confirmed 5-bar Williams fractal high; flat = unchanged over the last 5 bars

strategies.name: Intraday ATR Exhaustion Fade
strategies.entry: session_high - session_low > 1.5 * htf(atr(14), "1d") and close < close[1] and close > session_open
assumptions: the catalogue frames this as a profit-taking cap; tested as an intraday fade after an up-day range exceeds 1.5 x the prior daily ATR

strategies.name: Starc Bands Volatility Breakout
strategies.entry: close > sma(close, 6) + 2 * atr(15) and volume > 2 * sma(volume, 20)

strategies.name: 3-Week Tight Closes (O'Neil)
strategies.entry: all_of(abs(close - close[1]) / close[1] < 0.015, 3)[1] and close > highest(high, 3)[1]
assumptions: three tight weekly closes before the breakout week; 'near highs' not separately tested

strategies.name: High-Tight Flag (Power Play)
strategies.entry: roc(close, 40)[15] > 0.80 and (highest(high, 15) - lowest(low, 15)) / highest(high, 15) < 0.15 and close > highest(high, 15)[1]
assumptions: pole = 40-bar gain ending 15 bars ago; flag drawdown approximated by the 15-bar range relative to its high

strategies.name: Parkinson Volatility Breakout
strategies.entry: cross_above(parkinson(10), sma(parkinson(10), 30)) and barssince(parkinson(10) == lowest(parkinson(10), 30)) <= 10 and close > close[1]
assumptions: 'from 30-day low' = the volatility trough was within the last 10 bars; long only on an up close (direction unspecified)

strategies.name: Yang-Zhang Overnight Gap Volatility Filter
strategies.entry: hv(20) > hv(20)[5] and stdev(log(close / open), 20) > stdev(log(open / close[1]), 20) and close > sma(close, 20)
assumptions: Yang-Zhang volatility approximated by close-to-close HV; intraday vs overnight from open/close; long direction requires close > SMA20 (the catalogue gives a filter, not a direction)

strategies.name: Squeeze Pro (Ultra-Tight Compression)
strategies.entry: bb_upper(close, 20, 2) < kc_upper(20, 1.0) and bb_lower(close, 20, 2) > kc_lower(20, 1.0)
assumptions: literal compression state; long-only interpretation
